utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Please be seated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is the case number IT-04-74-A, the Prosecutor versus Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me first make sure that the audio equipment is functioning properly. Can the appellants hear the proceedings in a language they understand? Let me begin with Mr. Prlic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PRLIC
utterances.text: I'm able to hear you, but this equipment [Overlapping speakers].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I see you have some problems there. I see that the security is trying to fix it. Okay now, Mr. Prlic?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PRLIC
utterances.text: Yeah, it's okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: It's okay now. Thank you. Mr. Stojic. You can hear me, right?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT STOJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Everything is fine, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Praljak. I see yes. Thank you very much. Mr. Petkovic. Thank you -- it's okay? Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Everything is all right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I would like to note that on 7 May Mr. Pusic filed his consent to hold today's Status Conference in his absence. I also understand that Mr. Coric has waived his right to be present today because he is feeling unwell. I would now like to call for the appearances. For the -- well, for the Prosecution. May I?

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Yes. Good afternoon, Mr. President. For the Prosecution it's Douglas Stringer, Luke Fadem, legal interns Sophie Beelaerts van Blokland, Thomas Wooden, and our Case Manager, Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I see the interns are taking over the OTP.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: They indeed are, Mr. President. They're an excellent group.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I am sure they are. Thank you, Mr. Stringer. Before calling for the appearances for the Defence, I note that Mr. Petkovic filed his waiver of his -- waiver of his right to be represented by his counsel and co-counsel during this conference today, during this Status Conference. So for the Defence for Mr. Prlic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. President. Michael Karnavas and Suzana Tomanovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Karnavas. For Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Your Honour. For Mr. Stojic, I am Senka Nozica and --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. Nozica. For Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And Molly Martin pro bono.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU-IVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. For Mr. Praljak, Natacha Fauveau-Ivanovic, co-counsel.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: I'm just waiting to make sure that -- wait until we are final. It came, yeah. Thank you very much, Ms. Fauveau-Ivanovic. For Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I'm Mr. Drazen Plavec, co-counsel for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Drazen Plavec. For Mr. Pusic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Your Honour. I am Fahrudin Ibrisimovic for Mr. Pusic, with Mr. Sahota.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Ibrisimovic. As you are aware, Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days after the last Status Conference has been held for each appellant in the Tribunal's custody. A Status Conference serves two primary purposes. First, it allows the appellants an opportunity to express concerns relating to their appeal or detention conditions and for the Tribunal to inquire about the mental and physical condition of the detained persons. Second, it provides an opportunity to update the appellants with respect to the status of their case. I now turn to before -- before turning to the health situation, I would like to remind everybody that the last Status Conference was held on the 21st of January, and, therefore -- and that the Status Conference of today was scheduled by order -- order which I issued on May 4 just sometime ago. So now I turn to the principal object of this conference to inquire into the status of the detention conditions and the health situation of the appellants. If any of the appellants wish it, this discussion can take place in a closed session. Anyone who would like me to close the session? I see no desire to close the session, so we will continue with the public session. Mr. Prlic, anything to raise?

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PRLIC
utterances.text: No, Mr. President. I think that my mental and physical condition are still okay. Hoping that it is going to continue as such. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: You certainly look very well, if I may say so. Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT STOJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Your Honour. Everything is fine. I don't have any problems. That's the situation right now. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. I'm very pleased to hear that. Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PRALJAK
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I don't have any problems. I have been bearing the situation really well for the past 11 and a half years and I will continue to do so. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much, indeed. Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I don't have any problems. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: And finally for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, according to our information, in general Mr. Coric is absolutely okay. I think at the moment he has some minor difficulties. They may not even be difficulties, but he was actually undergoing some medical examinations and there was some -- he had some X-rays done and so for the -- for 24 hours he needs to rest, but otherwise there are no major problems involved.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much indeed. So let me now turn to summarise the recent procedural history. All of the appellants' brief in this case were filed on 12 January, 2015; and all the Defence and Prosecution respondents' briefs were filed on 7 May 2015. The Defence and Prosecution's reply briefs are to be filed no later than 29 of May. I note that all of the respondents' briefs, except for Mr. Petkovic and Mr. Pusic, were filed confidentially. I would ask that counsel file public redacted versions of these briefs in a timely manner, which I would consider to be - and I hope this is agreeable - within 30 days of today. If there are any confidential appellants briefs remaining to be filed publicly, I would ask that counsel do so within the same time-frame. And now the next point on my agenda is to ask the parties whether they are any other issues that they would like to raise, and let me start from the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Nothing from the Prosecution, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Stringer. And from the Defence. Let me go one by one. For Mr. Prlic, any questions?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Nothing, Your Honour. Thank you for asking.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Mr. Stojic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NOZICA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We have nothing. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Praljak.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU-IVANOVIC
utterances.text: Nothing, Your Honour. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Petkovic, for Mr. Petkovic.

utterances.speaker: THE APPELLANT PETKOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] We don't have any questions. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. And finally for Mr. Coric.

utterances.speaker: MR. PLAVEC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Nothing Your Honour, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Since there are no other matters to be raised, I thank the parties for their attendance and adjourn these proceedings.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: at 3.14 p.m.
